description: Community ratings for touchstone entries in data/touchstones.json. Fed by async helpers via docs/rate.html (prefilled GitHub issue) and folded in with `node scripts/touchstone-ratings.js ingest`. Source of truth for the wheat/chaff feedback loop: scripts/touchstones.js pick({useRatings:true}) floats high-rated entries up; lowRated() lists drop-candidates. Unrated entries score 3 by convention. Human-editable, git-diffable.
